description: Source code for a custom MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) memory allocator implementation in PyTorch, managing buffer pools, memory pressure, garbage collection, and integration with Metal API on Apple devices.

classes.name: MPSAllocator
classes.description: PyTorch MPS memory allocator class implementing IMPSAllocator interface, managing Metal buffers and memory pools.

classes.name: MPSHeapAllocatorImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation class handling buffer pool management, garbage collection, and memory pressure for MPS.

classes.name: BufferBlock
classes.description: Represents a buffer block in the allocator, including Metal buffer, size, shape, and metadata.

classes.name: HeapBlock
classes.description: Represents a heap of Metal buffers used for allocations.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of BufferBlocks, including available buffers, heaps, and usage flags.

methods.name: init_allocator
methods.description: Initializes the allocator, setting buffer pools and memory pressure ratios based on environment variables.

methods.name: init_buffer_pools
methods.description: Creates and configures buffer pools for different usage modes and sizes.

methods.name: get_pool
methods.description: Selects the appropriate buffer pool based on requested size and usage flags.

methods.name: alloc_buffer_block
methods.description: Allocates a new buffer block, handling memory pressure and pool selection.

methods.name: free_buffer
methods.description: Releases a buffer block back to its pool.

methods.name: release_buffer
methods.description: Removes a buffer block from active use and updates pool metadata.

methods.name: garbage_collect_cached_buffers
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on cached buffers to reduce memory usage under pressure.
